title: deyeuxia groenlandica
intro: Deyeuxia groenlandica, commonly known as Greenland grass or sweet grass, is a type of flowering plant native to the Arctic regions. This plant is valued for its sweet, grass-like fragrance and its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of Deyeuxia groenlandica include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions, such as antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also include antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
